correction.text: new keyframe, years only: the shape of Cliopatria's 1976 row holds from independence on 12 July 1975

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. Infobox 'Granted: 12 July 1975'; 'achieved independence on 12 July 1975, choosing as the first president the MLSTP Secretary General Manuel Pinto da Costa'. Cliopatria's row starts in 1976.

1,485 km2 against the infobox 964 km2 (ratio 1.54, inside a factor of two); the bbox covers both islands (6.30-7.34 E, 0.03-1.70 N). The gazetteer draws it as 2 cells against 4 for the country, a grid-resolution difference for two small islands.

region.text: the islands of São Tomé and Príncipe

ledger.note: 1975: São Tomé and Príncipe becomes independent from Portugal. Infobox 'Granted: 12 July 1975'; 'achieved independence on 12 July 1975, choosing as the first president the MLSTP Secretary General Manuel Pinto da Costa.' The country 'consists of two archipelagos around the two main islands of São Tomé and Príncipe'.

certainty.note: An island state: the coast is the border. The page records no territorial or maritime change; the 2001 joint development zone with Nigeria is a shared exploration area, not a border change.

sources.title: São Tomé and Príncipe
sources.note: Identity, independence (12 July 1975), capital, infobox area 964 km2, settlement 1493 and 1500, coups of 2003, 2009 and 2022 (no territorial effect).

notes: Only one page was opened (budget 1-2 pages, three shapes). The page does not say when the islands became an overseas province. The three coup events (July 2003, February 2009 attempt, November 2022 attempt) moved no border and are not in the ledger. Independence is 12 July 1975 and Cliopatria starts in 1976: the 1975 keyframe is new.
